Everyone's complaining about groceries... but this is the thing. What large jewelers (basically monopolies) are doing is what EVERY company is doing including your grocery store.

Yeah, it may sound out of touch to talk about jewelry... but this applies to cars, this applies to appliances, this applies to houses, this applies to fast food. These companies are ALL price gouging and cutting corners in the name of increased profits for SHAREHOLDERS because they can and you have no other choice but to pay because they control 50%, 60%, 80% of the market. This is EXACTLY why we criminalized monopolies, but law is only effective if it is enforced and conservatives do NOT enforce those laws.

There are brand new cars in the world today that sell for less than $15k in the world, but not in America because that would undercut the extortionate profits of the US car industry. Houses are only built when it is profitable, because that industry has successfully lobbied and convinced NIMBYs and government officials that subsidized development JUST to increase supply for future growth is bad. It doesn't matter where you buy groceries because each one is probably owned by the same parent company, even if the store logo is different.

replies.text:
No, it's 100% a real diamond. Carbon square shaped lattice. In fact, a lab grown diamond will be clearer and larger than 99.9999% of the "real" diamonds out there.

And anyone who tells you there is a trick to distinguish between the two is wrong. There is no way to distinguish between the two. Those issues from the 90s have been fixed. In fact, lab grown is even better than a "real" diamond for another great reason. It guarantees it is NOT a blood diamond.

The only difference between a lab grown and "real" is some romanticized notion you have of some rock coming out of the earth, often at the hands of slavery, is better than rock coming out of a lab. Me, I find a conflict free rock much more romantic than a bloodstained one. Why would you want a bloodstained rock cursing your relationship since you seem to believe superstitious stuff?
